The decisive error was made by the Assistant at Step 36. It concluded that Al Gore was the answer, but the correct members are Wanda Austin, Ronald D. Sugar and Sue Wagner. The Assistant also misstated Andrea Jung's history, and it ignored the point that the question concerns the role held at the time of joining the board. Sue Wagner co-founded BlackRock but was not in a C-suite role when she joined, and Ron Sugar was likewise not a CEO at joining. The Assistant did not check these, so its final answer was wrong.
